subject: Company-side newsletter signals beside your candidate data
body:
Your sourcing is described as ATS, job boards and the open web, and your blog puts the open-web figure at over a billion professional profiles. Newsletter coverage is outside that, and it points at companies rather than candidates: which publications wrote about a hiring brand, and who sponsors them.

NewsletterFIT holds more than 27,000 publications and 143,000 articles with company, people, topic and sponsor extraction, each with source URL and date. It would sit beside your candidate data, not replace it, and I am not going to pretend we have resumes.

If a company-level signal is useful to your product team, I can send a sample. If not, one line saying so closes it.

retired.reason: Not a prospect: research verdict 47/100. Sourcing needs candidate profiles and resumes, which NF does not produce, and they already run 1B+ profiles.
